findings.title: Dirty source tree needs triage before authoritative review
evidence: git status --short over reviewed source roots reported approximately 1033 modified files, 52 deleted files, and 134 untracked files.
Source-like untracked examples include docs/workflows/TASK_REVIEW_WEB_APP.md, trace/review_app/, scripts/run_review_app.py, and tests/test_review_app.py.
findings.impact: Review, release readiness, and calibration provenance are unreliable while intentional source changes are mixed with untracked files and unrelated dirty state.
findings.recommendation: Split the workspace into intentional change sets and either stage or explicitly discard every source-like file before treating the branch as reviewable.
findings.validation_target: git status --short over source roots is clean or contains only the intended patch.
findings.resolution: Cache directories, notebook checkpoint directories, and Python bytecode under active source/review roots were removed. Dirty-tree manifest created at review/code-review/2026-05-30-dirty-tree-triage.md and .json, with cleanup action list at review/code-review/2026-05-30-cr001-cleanup-action-list.md. Deleted tracked files were reviewed as retired/inactive surfaces to keep deleted, including deleted illustration code/test paths after checking for active import references; untracked source-like files were reviewed as active additions to keep/stage. Remaining tracked-modified files need commit splitting rather than blind reversion.

findings.title: Benchmark coverage scripts reference inactive task ids
findings.impact: Coverage links can silently disappear or point future task planning at retired task surfaces.
findings.recommendation: Replace hard-coded task-id lists with registry-derived lookups where possible, and annotate any retired historical ids with active replacements.
findings.validation_target: A registry scan reports zero unannotated inactive task ids in benchmark review scripts.
findings.resolution: Benchmark/coverage scripts now reference active task ids, and tests/test_docs_consistency.py scans those scripts for inactive task-id references.

findings.title: Icon complexity skill references removed icon task ids
evidence: Removed task ids remain in icon complexity guidance, including reference_canvas, pair_grid, and pattern_grid task ids.
findings.impact: Agents can calibrate icon difficulty against stale task families.
findings.recommendation: Update the skill reference to active icon task ids or mark old ids as historical examples with explicit replacements.
findings.validation_target: Skill/document task-id scan reports zero unannotated missing ids.
findings.resolution: Icon complexity guidance now uses active icon task ids, and scripts/check_skill_consistency.py scans skill Markdown for inactive task-id references.

findings.title: Code review guideline rule numbering has duplicates
evidence: Duplicate numbers were found in the same distilled-list sequence: 27, 28, 80-83, 143-144, 191, and 198.
findings.impact: Reviewers cannot cite rules unambiguously and append-only drift is likely to continue.
findings.recommendation: Renumber the distilled-list section or convert it to unnumbered bullets plus stable anchors for high-value rules.
findings.validation_target: Duplicate-rule-number scan reports no duplicates within one numbered sequence.
findings.resolution: docs/workflows/CODE_REVIEW_GUIDELINES.md section 2 was renumbered contiguously, and tests/test_docs_consistency.py rejects duplicate or non-contiguous numbering.

findings.title: Project metadata under-declares dependencies
evidence: pyproject.toml declares dependencies = [] while requirements.txt lists runtime, rendering, validation, testing, and review-app dependencies.
findings.impact: pip install . can create an environment that cannot run core generation, rendering, tests, or the review app.
findings.recommendation: Move runtime dependencies into project metadata with optional extras, or document that TRACE must be installed from requirements.txt.
findings.validation_target: A clean virtual environment installed through the documented path can import core modules and run doc consistency tests.
findings.resolution: Runtime dependencies now live in pyproject.toml under [project].dependencies, while test and review-app tooling are available through [project.optional-dependencies] extras. README.md documents editable installs with pip install -e ".[test,review]", and requirements.txt remains valid as the all-in-one bootstrap path.

findings.title: Shared/facade monolithic hotspots were split into narrower ownership modules
evidence: graph_sampling.py is now a 142-line compatibility facade; graph sampler families are split into graph_node_degree_sampling.py (~848), graph_path_order_sampling.py (~793), graph_reachability_sampling.py (~557), graph_component_sampling.py (~436), graph_bridge_articulation_sampling.py (~397), graph_isolation_sampling.py (~361), graph_mst_sampling.py (~181), graph_edge_path_label_sampling.py (~132), and the previously extracted source/sink/common-neighbor/label-color/degree helpers.

object_scene_rendering.py is now about 371 lines; named-object glyph rendering is split across object_scene_glyphs_symbolic.py (~835), household (~490), nature/apparel (~489), tools/devices (~484), misc (~682), and large-object family modules all under ~555 lines.
chart_scene.py is now a 40-line compatibility facade; chart renderers are split into labeled (~983), multiseries (~574), stacked (~469), histogram (~248), boxplot (~622), and violin (~314) modules.

choropleth_region_label.py is now about 602 lines; config (~351), top-level dataset (~687), region/world/marker dataset helpers (~384/~446/~266), base rendering (~955), and marker rendering (~324) are split into map-local modules.

camera_distance.py remains about 750 lines after object-scene extraction; intersection_nearest.py remains about 845 lines after street scene extraction; intersection_rendering.py is now about 83 lines after street-renderer-family extraction. Larger domain task files still exist elsewhere, but the repeated shared/facade hotspots from this CR-006 pass have been split.
scripts/run_task_review.py is about 820 lines after task-review helper extraction.

intersection_rendering.py is now about 83 lines after splitting street rendering into common (~261), road (~524), vehicle (~398), fixture/signage (~393), pedestrian (~268), building/storefront (~603), landscape/street furniture (~282), and dispatch (~127) modules.
findings.impact: Large files obscure ownership boundaries, increase review cost, and make shared-contract regressions harder to localize.
findings.recommendation: Split by stable responsibility such as sampling, contracts, rendering, projection, review export, and app indexing. Keep CLI files thin.
findings.validation_target: New helper modules have focused tests and existing smoke checks continue to pass.

findings.title: Chart skill duplicates docs and one read-first entry
evidence: The same rendering-upgrade workflow doc appears twice in the read-first list.
The skill carries detailed chart review policy that should remain canonical in workflow/domain docs.
findings.impact: Skill guidance can drift from source-of-truth docs and creates another surface to update during renderer-review changes.
findings.recommendation: Deduplicate the read-first list and keep this skill as a thin routing overlay to canonical docs.
findings.validation_target: Skill consistency check passes and chart review policy is stated once in canonical docs.
findings.resolution: skills/domain-charts/SKILL.md no longer repeats the information-scene workflow in the read-first list, and its detailed review/handoff bullets now defer to canonical workflow/domain docs.

findings.title: Coordinate geometry default resolver helper is duplicated
evidence: The same _resolve_int_param implementation appears in three coordinate geometry task modules.
findings.impact: Small helper behavior can drift as new coordinate tasks copy local implementations.
findings.recommendation: Promote common parameter/default resolvers into a coordinate-domain shared helper.
findings.validation_target: Coordinate tasks import the shared helper and existing default/config behavior remains unchanged.
findings.resolution: trace/tasks/geometry/coordinate/params.py now owns resolve_int_param(...), and coordinate algebra, locus-region, and quadrilateral task modules import it instead of defining local copies.
